ILLARI

Guayaquil through radar

Compare the NISAR radar signal over the same urban area on 7 and 19 October 2026. Across the full scene, the median change was +0.23 dB in HH and +0.13 dB in HV.

Choose HH or HV, then move the slider below the first map. The second map shows the difference at each pixel. Blue means a weaker return on 19 October, orange means a stronger return and pale colours indicate little change.

Area A · Box A covers 500 × 500 m. Across its 2,500 pixels, the median difference was +0.67 dB in HH and +0.64 dB in HV. It was selected to illustrate a local increase.

Moisture, vegetation and surface structure can affect the return. The 26 October storm occurred after both acquisitions.

Calibrated NASA–ISRO NISAR L2 GCOV PROVISIONAL subsets. Descending track 112, frame 090, mode 4005, DHDH. UTM 17S (EPSG:32717), 1,335 × 1,327 pixels at 10 m spacing. Differences and medians were calculated on the original grid. Maps were reduced for display. Reproduce the calculation.
